column2: [intro]
In my mind, thoughts take flight,
Each one more quirky, more bright.
I juggle words, I laugh with glee,
It’s my way of life, my sweet spree.
In the world of little ironies,
We play with life’s paradoxes with ease.
We dance on reality’s toes,
With lightness and joy, oh how it glows!
I crack jokes, puns in a stream,
The world is my stage, my dream.
They say, "You’re crazy, you overdo,"
But I make smiles, that’s my true view.
Let’s travel to the realm of sarcasm,
Where smiles have their own magnetism.
Absurd situations, winks so sly,
We find fun in all, it’s our radiant high.
[ solo ]
In the world of little ironies,
We play with life’s paradoxes with ease.
We dance on reality’s toes,
With lightness and joy, oh how it glows!
[outro]
